criteria.text: `pdd run --save-last finish-task` shows the last confirmed run's input, data before and output, then asks "Is this answer right? [y/N]".
Answering y adds that input and observed output as one new step of the existing Story test, which can be selected by `pdd test finish-task`.
Answering N, an empty answer or any answer other than y writes nothing and explains how to write the right expected value by hand.
Without terminal input and output, saving writes nothing and says that a person must answer in a terminal.
After saving, the message names the test file and actual step, asks me to review the data before it, and gives `pdd test finish-task`.
An unknown run, changed prompt, missing starting data or starting data incompatible with the Story continuation cannot become a saved passing test.
